events.name: The Winston
events.blurb:
For its Philadelphia debut, The Pregame brought curated Young Professionals under one roof, spanning tech, entertainment, sports, music, and top agencies. These are early- to mid-career professionals who are building, connected, and influential within their networks.

Sponsored by OneSeed Entertainment, the night featured an open bar, three DJs, and an atmosphere designed to make introductions feel effortless. 

We loved this one because it was in our team’s hometown, and we were able to prove that The Pregame had demand for more sponsors and more professionals.

events.name: Café Unido Part 2
events.blurb:
Thankfully, Unido allowed us to run it back, but this time even bigger and better.

This event featured a sponsor, Yatts, a tattoo interface that lets artists run their businesses and customers book appointments through the app (amazing idea). They activated by giving invitees their own temporary "Yatts" tattoos and informing them about Yatts, while also adding a cool LED sign.

818 Tequila came in, and we used them for every drink. Shout out to them!

This one was special because it proved how natural the space can be with partners.

events.name: Café Unido Part 1
events.blurb:
Café Unido Shaw warmly welcomed us into their space, providing an ideal setting for The Pregame event without a bar. It was an incredible experience.

The night hosted approximately 80 guests, predominantly from Howard University.

Our photographers captured the memorable evening exclusively on film, which is what you’ll find in our recap. If you’re interested in viewing our recap on VHS, it’s available on our Instagram.

events.name: Foundry Gallery
events.writeup: Washington, D.C., February 2026. Sixty guests inside Foundry Gallery — walls covered in work from local artists, the kind of room that makes you slow down and actually look. The space did the work before anyone said a word. People who didn't know each other left knowing each other. That was the point.
